items.title: [Feature][DSA] Share O-projection buffers across DeepSeek layers
items.author: rikakuhi
items.excerpt: This PR reduces resident OTP communication-buffer memory for DeepSeek V4 and V4.1 by sharing address-stable O-projection exchange scratch across sequential DSA layers. It reserves the shared buffers before KV-cache profiling and sizes them
items.titleZh: 【功能】【DSA】Share O-projection buffers across DeepSeek layers
items.excerptZh: This PR reduces resident OTP 通信-buffer 显存 for DeepSeek V4 and V4.1 by sharing address-stable O-projection exchange scratch across sequential DSA layers. It reserves the 共享 buffers before KV-缓存 profiling and sizes them
